name: Alterac Signet Ring
summary: An Alterac Signet Ring marks a Syndicate member as one of the former nobles behind the gang. Magistrate Maleb in Southshore seeks these rings to weaken the Syndicate's leadership.

sections.title: A Noble's Mark
sections.body: In the ruins of Strahnbrad, Alterac Signet Rings mark Syndicate agents who once belonged to Alterac's nobility. Magistrate Maleb in Southshore wants them gathered. He fears the Syndicate's leaders mean to ruin the town, and believes stripping them of their rings will leave the gang unable to act with purpose.

faq.q: What is an Alterac Signet Ring?
faq.answer: An Alterac Signet Ring is worn by a Syndicate agent who is one of the gang's former nobles.
Magistrate Maleb in Southshore wants the rings to weaken the Syndicate's leadership.

faq.q: Where can I find the rings?
faq.answer: Syndicate members in Alterac Mountains carry Alterac Signet Rings, and the ruins of Strahnbrad are thought to be the gang's headquarters.

faq.q: Why does Maleb want the rings?
faq.answer: Magistrate Maleb believes removing the Syndicate's former nobles will leave the gang unable to act decisively.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, Maleb asks you to help protect Southshore by weakening the Syndicate's leadership.
